{"consolidated_memory":"CACHE MISS STORM IN build/bazel/BUILD.bazel — THREE SEPARATE INCIDENTS

All three incidents involved the same core symptom: rebuild of targets that should have been cached in the build graph, reproduced by building twice with no source change. Each had a distinct root cause and fix, resolved on three separate dates.

INCIDENT 1: [2026-02-18]
Trigger: payloads above roughly two megabytes
Root cause: missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
Fix: added composite index and backfilled in batches
PR #2975, branch fix/cache-miss-storm-1
Result: alert stayed quiet for 78 consecutive days

INCIDENT 2: [2026-04-06]
Trigger: clients pinned to v1 SDK
Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
Fix: raised pool ceiling and added bounded wait queue in front
PR #3015, branch fix/cache-miss-storm-2
Result: memory settled at 194 MB instead of climbing past 3 GB

INCIDENT 3: [2026-04-19]
Trigger: two requests racing on the same key
Root cause: mutable default argument shared across calls
Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call
PR #3606, branch fix/cache-miss-storm-3
Stack: Starlark
Covering check: remote cache hit rate check in CI
Result: error rate dropped from 9.4 percent to under 5 per ten thousand"}
